title: The Math Test
scene: 考试那天，题目难不难，考完等成绩，下次怎么办

sentences.text: I have a math test today, and I worry a little.
sentences.gloss: 我今天有一场数学考试，我有点担心。

sentences.text: The teacher gives us the paper, and I take my pen and my pencil.
sentences.gloss: 老师把试卷发给我们，我拿出我的钢笔和铅笔。

sentences.text: I try to remember the words I practice every day.
sentences.gloss: 我努力想起我每天练习的那些词。

sentences.text: The first questions are easy, but the last one is difficult.
sentences.gloss: 前面几道题很容易，但最后一道很难。

sentences.text: I forget one answer, so I make a mistake there.
sentences.gloss: 有一个答案我忘了，所以那里我做错了。

sentences.text: I finish before the end of the class, and then I check my answers again.
sentences.gloss: 我在下课前做完了，然后又检查了一遍我的答案。

sentences.text: One answer is wrong, and I write the correct one.
sentences.gloss: 有一个答案是错的，我把正确的写上去。

sentences.text: The result comes on Friday: my score is better than last time, and I get a good grade.
sentences.gloss: 星期五成绩出来了：我的分数比上次好，我得了一个好等级。

sentences.text: I am proud of it, and next time I will practice more.
sentences.gloss: 我为此感到自豪，下次我会多练习。
